en.t: Tomorrow? ... Tomorrow would be a problem...

units.source_text: 男人吃吃地笑出声来，实际上他巧妙地把谈话切入了正题，

en.t: The man gave a chuckling laugh; in fact, he had skillfully steered the conversation to the real point,

units.source_text: “说是这么说，到底什么时候，才能请你们让我到上面去呢？

en.t: That may be so, but when exactly can I ask you to let me go up above?

units.source_text: 对我这种有工作的人来说，预定超过半天，将会带来多大的损失呀……

en.t: For someone like me, who has work to do, going more than half a day over schedule would cause a terrible loss...
I certainly do not want to waste time...

units.source_text: 有一种叫做斑蝥的，就是那种贴着地面噗噗飞着走的虫……

en.t: There is a kind of insect called a blister beetle, the sort that flutters along close to the ground...

units.source_text: 听说沙地上很多，你没听说过吗？

en.t: I hear there are many of them in sandy places. Have you never heard of them?

units.source_text: ……我本打算利用这回的休假，把这种虫的新种弄到手……”

en.t: ... I had planned to use this vacation to get my hands on a new species of that insect...
